name: Tomatoes
shortDescription: Vine-ripened, juicy local tomatoes packed with natural flavor and lycopene.
description: Locally grown vine-ripened tomatoes, harvested at peak freshness. Perfect for vibrant summer salads, hearty sauces, and everyday cooking. Grown pesticide-free by regional growers.
nutrition: High in Lycopene, Vitamin C, Potassium, and Vitamin K.

name: Mangoes
shortDescription: Sweet, aromatic tropical mangoes naturally tree-ripened for maximum sweetness.
description: Rich golden mangoes directly sourced from sun-drenched orchards. Known for their melt-in-the-mouth texture and rich honeyed aroma. Excellent for smoothies, desserts, or fresh eating.
nutrition: Rich in Vitamin A, Vitamin C, Dietary Fiber, and Antioxidants.

name: Apples
shortDescription: Crisp and tart local orchard apples handpicked at optimal autumn harvest.
description: Freshly picked crisp orchard apples with a delightful sweet-tart balance. Ideal for healthy snacking, seasonal baking, fresh cider, and autumn pies.
nutrition: Packed with Pectin fiber, Vitamin C, and Polyphenols.

name: Fresh Mint
shortDescription: Fragrant spearmint and peppermint harvested fresh on market morning.
description: Vibrant and aromatic freshly harvested mint bunches. Brings invigorating freshness to cool beverages, herbal teas, dressings, chutneys, and Mediterranean bowls.
nutrition: Rich in Menthol, Iron, Folate, and Digestive Enzymes.

name: Cucumbers
shortDescription: Crisp, refreshing seedless cucumbers perfect for hydration and salads.
description: Tender-skinned, crunchy farm cucumbers grown without chemical sprays. Exceptionally refreshing, crisp, and high in natural hydration for hot summer afternoons.
nutrition: Contains 95% water, Silica, Vitamin K, and Potassium.

name: Potatoes
shortDescription: Earthy, wholesome organic new potatoes great for roasting and mashing.
description: Locally harvested unwashed new potatoes full of natural goodness. Versatile for golden roasts, velvety soups, stews, and fluffy homemade mash.
nutrition: Great source of Potassium, Vitamin B6, Fiber, and Complex Carbs.

name: Baby Spinach
shortDescription: Tender dark green spinach leaves harvested cold for peak sweetness.
description: Nutrient-dense dark green winter spinach with soft tender leaves. Grown in cool climate conditions that heighten its natural mild sweetness. Wonderful raw or lightly steamed.
nutrition: High in Iron, Lutein, Calcium, Vitamin A, and Folate.

name: Sweet Oranges
shortDescription: Sun-kissed citrus bursting with refreshing juice and bright acidity.
description: Tree-ripened winter citrus brimming with sweet, invigorating juice. Hand-selected for deep color, thin peel, and optimal juiciness.
nutrition: Powerhouse of Vitamin C, Thiamine, and Citrus Bioflavonoids.

name: Farm Carrots
shortDescription: Crisp sweet heirloom carrots with fresh green tops intact.
description: Sweet root carrots harvested with their leafy tops on. Exceptionally sweet and crunchy, whether enjoyed raw, roasted with honey, or juiced.
nutrition: Exceptional Beta-carotene (Vitamin A), Biotin, and Fiber.

name: Strawberries
shortDescription: Fragrant ruby-red spring strawberries picked ripe this morning.
description: Deep red, intensely aromatic strawberries cultivated in local soil. Unlike supermarket strawberries, these are completely sweet right through to the core.
nutrition: Rich in Ellagic Acid, Vitamin C, Manganese, and Folate.

name: Farm Milk
shortDescription: Whole fresh pasteurized milk from pasture-raised local cows.
description: Creamy, minimally processed farm fresh milk bottled within hours of milking. Produced by grass-fed herds on ethical regional dairy farms.
nutrition: Rich in Bioavailable Calcium, Vitamin D, Protein, and B12.

name: Raw Honey
shortDescription: Pure unpasteurized wildflower honey from local community apiaries.
description: Raw, unfiltered golden honey carrying the distinctive pollen signatures of local seasonal wildflowers. Rich in enzymes and soothing natural sweetness.
nutrition: Natural Antioxidants, Pollen enzymes, and Antimicrobial benefits.
